description_en: Supports structured recognition and output of key fields such as invoice code, invoice number, date, and invoice amount
description_zh: 支持包括发票代码、发票号码、日期、发票金额等关键字段结构化识别输出
kebab_example: aliyun ocr-api recognize-taxi-invoice --url https://img.alicdn.com/tfs/TB1.OicXebviK0jSZFNXXaApXXa-364-982.jpg --biz-body '图片二进制文件' --region cn-hangzhou
name: RecognizeTaxiInvoice

parameters.help_en:
This field and the body field are mutually exclusive; you must specify one and only one of them.  
Image URL (must not exceed 2048 bytes in length; base64 is not supported).
parameters.help_zh:
本字段和body字段二选一，不可同时透传或同时为空。
图片链接（长度不超2048字节，不支持base64）
parameters.name: url

parameters.help_en:
This field and the URL field are mutually exclusive; you must specify one and only one of them.  
Binary file of the image, up to 10 MB in size.  
When using HTTP, upload the binary file by placing it in the HTTP body.  
When using the software development kit (SDK), place the image in the SDK's body.
parameters.help_zh:
本字段和URL字段二选一，不可同时透传或同时为空。
图片二进制文件，最大10MB。
使用HTTP方式调用，把图片二进制文件放到HTTP body中上传即可。
使用SDK的方式调用，把图片放到SDK的body中即可
parameters.name: body

Code.description_en: Error code (this field is not returned if detection succeeded)
Code.description_zh: 错误码（如果识别成功，不会返回此字段）

Message.description_en: Error message (this field is not returned if detection succeeded)
Message.description_zh: 错误提示（如果识别成功，不会返回此字段）
Message.example: You are not authorized to perform this operation.
